description: Answer "did <tool> reset its usage limits today?" for one AI coding tool: whether a reset happened in the last 24 hours, the last reset time (UTC), hours since, the estimated probability of a reset in the next 24 hours, and a link to the live page with the official source.

tool.description: Slug of the AI coding tool to check, e.g. codex. One of: codex, claude-code, cursor, gemini-cli, copilot, kiro, windsurf, antigravity.

name: get_reset_status

alerts_url.description: Where to get an alert when the tool (or any tool) resets next: free, no account

forecast_status.description: ok, or why there is no estimate (e.g. no_history, paused)

probability_24h.description: Estimated chance of a reset within 24 h (0–1)

reset_in_last_24h.description: true when the last usage-limit reset was less than 24 hours ago

url.description: Live page with the history and official sources

title: Did this tool reset today?
